# PLAN: build-time

**RFC:** none — objective from ARCHITECT's prompt (session `build-time-optimization`)
**Date:** 2026-11-09
**BLESSED Compliance:** verified
**Language Constraints:** CMake 4.4.5 + Ninja, generated by cast from `cast/cmake.cast` and markdown tables; C++17 / JUCE / JAM only for the generated `files::` constant

## Context

ARCHITECT: *"i wonder there is genuienely we could done to make the building, compiling process even faster? especially iterative build with debug"*.

These timings are ARCHITECT's own, measured from `.ninja_log`:
- EVE Debug, one jam edit: 43.2 s, with 32.8 s post-build and 6.3 s compile.
- END Release, full build: 232 s.

Scope, verbatim: *"[x] Selected-format SSOT … [x] Install gate + 1-arch Debug … [x] END PCH + job pool … [x] ccache … write RFC to MACHINIST to ~/.config/ to execute"*. The archetype is also in scope (answer: "Also archetype").

### Rulings this plan executes (ARCHITECT, verbatim)

- *"EVE manifest by default (Release) must always build all, pack all, etc as now"*
- *"EVE could build specific format, specific arch (if feasible), etc by explicit args flag"*

- *"EVE cmake generate all seams it needs. its default, and its flaggable args for END to drive. so each project still encapsulated, independent"*
- *"if END build arm64 debug, EVE built arm64 debug too, one flag one row, but EVE has extra one flag for format"*
- *"this also must be driven by my nvim which already have default flag for debug and release (never sign), arch could be machine detection no?"*
- *"still the default `cast spell` is full chain, release, all format, universal, signed and notarized, etc"*
- *"the implementation must be written now, so it was written UNIVERSALLY. no hardcoding of any platform"*
- Answers given in this session:
  - END's chain names the EVE word literally: "END toolchain, literal".
  - One word carries the lane and the format: "One combined word".
  - Word shape: "vst-debug, vst-no-sign".
  - Format variable: "CAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT".
  - Runtime row: "mac/win columns".
  - Archetype: "Also archetype".
  - Architecture: "Universal in template".
- Pack stays in Debug: *"ensure both release and debug build always run post build copy to end repo"* (`carol/SPRINT-LOG.md:502`).

### Facts the design rests on

- Cast takes one `--<word>` per run (`cast/SPEC.md:94`, `cast/Source/main.cpp:352-355`).
- A toolchain cell resolves an alias only when the alias is the whole cell (`cast/Source/Model.cpp:978-979`).
- An empty `CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES` gives the host architecture:
  - *"If CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES is not set, the compiler's default target architecture is used. For compilers provided by Xcode, this is the host machine's architecture"* (`cmake/Help/variable/CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES.rst:10-12`).
  - CMake's own default for this cache entry is the empty environment value (`Modules/Platform/Darwin-Initialize.cmake:18-20`).
- `set(... CACHE)` does not overwrite an existing entry (`Help/command/set.rst:93-105`).
- `-U` removes a cache entry (`Help/manual/include/OPTIONS_BUILD.rst:77-84`).
- ccache needs these settings (ccache manual, *Precompiled headers*):
  - `sloppiness = pch_defines,time_macros`.
  - For clang, `-fno-pch-timestamp`.
- ccache does not support MSVC `/Zi` (ccache PR #1266; issue #1040 is open). CMP0141 is NEW under `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2.0)` (`Help/command/include/POLICY_VERSION.rst:11-12`), so `CMAKE_MSVC_DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT` selects the format.

## Language / Framework Constraints

- Generated files are never edited (`cast/SPEC.md:85`). Each change goes into a template (`cast/cmake.cast`, `cast/source.cast`, `init.cast`) or a table, and cast regenerates the file.
- Only ARCHITECT runs `cast`, `cmake` and `ninja` (END `CLAUDE.md` Build). COUNSELOR validates the template text and the table text.
- CODING.md: no comments, no doxygen (CAROL Code Hygiene).

- **CMake API, used as supplied:**
  - `CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER` (`Help/prop_tgt/LANG_COMPILER_LAUNCHER.rst:9-16`).
  - `find_program(... REQUIRED)` (`Help/command/include/FIND_XXX.rst:131`).
  - `CMAKE_MSVC_DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT` with `Embedded`, set before `project()` (`Help/variable/CMAKE_MSVC_DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT.rst:33-37`).
  - The `SHELL:` option prefix (`Help/command/include/OPTIONS_SHELL.rst:8-15`).
  - `JOB_POOLS` and `target_precompile_headers`, from the EVE sibling.
- **Sibling blocks, pasted verbatim into the Engineer prompts:**
  - Job pool: `eve/cast/cmake.cast:13-23`.
  - PCH: `eve/cast/cmake.cast:163-172`.
  - Table rows: `eve/project-info.md:116`, `:118`.
  - Fatal check: `eve/cast/cmake.cast:29-31`.

  - Per-platform C++: `jam/cast/code.cast:323-334` (`platform-value-lookup-table`) and `code.cast:45-51` (`identifier`, `identifier-definition`).

- **Runtime is already format-agnostic:**
  - `Session::getPluginFormat` asks each format (`Session.cpp:42-52`).
  - `Nexus::getOrCreatePlugin` reads `files::evePlugin` (`Nexus.cpp:199`).

- **Names this plan adds.** Approval of this plan ratifies them.
  - Ruled names: the `CAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT` cache variable and the words `vst-debug`, `vst3-debug`, `au-debug`, `vst-no-sign`, `vst3-no-sign`, `au-no-sign`.
  - From existing families: `CAST_CCACHE` (family `CAST_SIGNTOOL`), and the fence `platform-identifier-definition` (family `identifier-definition` + `platform-value-lookup-table`).
  - New: the table `## platform files` in `end/cast/files.md`.

## Validation Gate

COUNSELOR validates each step before the next one. Each step is checked against MANIFESTO.md (BLESSED), NAMES.md, ~/.carol/CODING.md, and the rulings quoted above. Nothing may deviate and the scope may not drift. @Auditor runs ONCE, after the final step, over the whole sprint. It never runs per step.

## Steps

### Step 1: EVE template — universal default, one-format narrowing, install gate
**Scope:** `eve/cast/cmake.cast`, `eve/project-info.md` (`## cmake`)
**Action:**
1. `cmake.cast:35`: replace `":::architecture:::"` with `"x86_64;arm64"`.
2. Delete the `architecture` row (`project-info.md:66`).
3. After `cmake.cast:53`, declare `set(CAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT "" CACHE STRING …)`.
4. When it is set, check membership against `CAST_FORMATS` with a `FATAL_ERROR`, in the shape of `:29-31`.
5. Then set `CAST_FORMATS` and `CAST_INSTALLER_FORMATS` to `${CAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT}`.
6. In the install gates (`:430`, `:460`), add `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release" AND NOT CAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT`.
**Validation:**
- No `:::architecture:::` is left.
- Sign and pack are unchanged. Pack still runs in Debug (`SPRINT-LOG.md:502`).
- The fatal follows the sibling shape.
- No other name is added.

### Step 2: EVE lanes — explicit arch and format on every cmake row
**Scope:** `eve/project-info.md` `## toolchain` (`:121-167`)
**Action:**
1. Universal lanes are the default, `standalone`, `vst`, `vst3` and `au`. Each gets `-UCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES -DCAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT=`.
2. The host lanes `debug` and `no-sign` get `-DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES= -DCAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT=`.
3. Add six lanes. Each has the three rows: `cast` jam spell, `cmake`, `ninja`.
   - `vst-debug`, `vst3-debug`, `au-debug`: `Builds/Debug`, Debug, `-DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES= -DCAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT=<VST|VST3|AU>`.
   - `vst-no-sign`, `vst3-no-sign`, `au-no-sign`: `Builds/Release`, Release, `-DCAST_SIGN=OFF` and the same two flags.
   - The `ninja` row has no target, so `post-build` packs.
**Validation:**
- Every cmake row states both the arch and the format, so a shared build folder cannot keep a stale cache value.
- The values come from `## plugin format` `value` (`:176-180`).

### Step 5: ccache, MSVC debug format, PCH timestamp — END and EVE templates
**Scope:** `end/cast/cmake.cast`, `eve/cast/cmake.cast`, `end/project-info.md` `## debug`, `eve/project-info.md` `## compile option`
**Action:**
1. Before `project()`, set `CMAKE_MSVC_DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT "$<$<CONFIG:Debug,RelWithDebInfo>:Embedded>"`.
2. After `project()`, call `find_program(CAST_CCACHE ccache REQUIRED)`.
3. Set `CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER` and `CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER`. END also sets `CMAKE_OBJC_COMPILER_LAUNCHER` and `CMAKE_OBJCXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER`, because END enables those languages (`end/cast/cmake.cast:17`).
4. Under `if(APPLE)`, add `target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE "SHELL:-Xclang -fno-pch-timestamp")`.
5. Blank the win cells that the CMake abstraction now owns: `end/project-info.md:278` (`/Zi`) and `eve/project-info.md:226` (`/Z7`). This follows CODING.md *configure only the difference*.
**Validation:**
- Each setting cites its CMake doc line or ccache manual line.
- No platform is hardcoded outside an `APPLE`/`WIN32` branch.
- `REQUIRED` fails fast (MANIFESTO E).

### Step 8: RFC to MACHINIST
**Scope:** `~/.config/RFC-ccache.md` (rfc-writer skill)
**Action:**
- Request ccache in `bootstrap-macos.sh`, in the Homebrew array (`:82-106`) and the MacPorts array (`:110-134`).
- Request `${PKG_PREFIX}-ccache` in `bootstrap-windows.sh` `PACMAN_PKGS` (`:289-310`). The MSYS2 packages exist for ucrt64, clang64 and mingw64, at 4.14.2.
- Request one monorepo `ccache.conf` with `sloppiness = pch_defines,time_macros,include_file_mtime,include_file_ctime`, found through `CCACHE_CONFIGPATH` in `~/.config/zsh/zshenv`.
- Give the reason: the templates call `find_program(... REQUIRED)`, so a machine without ccache fails at configure.
**Validation:** rfc-writer structure; every claim cited.

@Auditor runs once over Steps 1-8. COUNSELOR validates each finding per the Design by Contract Filter and resolves it in this sprint.

## Verification (ARCHITECT runs; agents never build)

1. MACHINIST executes the RFC. Check `ccache --version` on each machine.
2. In EVE, run `cast spell --vst-debug`. Check:
   - Only `EVE_VST` builds.
   - `lipo -info` shows the host architecture.
   - Nothing installs into `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins`.
   - `unzip -l "end/Source/plugins/EVE v0.0.1 macOS.zip"` lists `EVE.vst/` only.
3. In END, run `cast cast/spell.md --debug`. Check:
   - The chain calls `--vst-debug`.
   - END builds for the host.
   - A pane loads EVE.
4. Touch one jam header and build again with `--debug`. Compare `.ninja_log` with the 43.2 s baseline, and check `ccache -s` for hits.
5. Run the default `cast cast/spell.md` in END. It is still universal (`lipo -info`: x86_64 arm64), with all EVE formats, and signed and notarized.
6. The Windows build is checked later on a Windows machine (ARCHITECT: *"the actual testing/hardening will eventually get on actual windows machine"*).

## BLESSED Alignment

- **S (SSOT):**
  - EVE's format list stays in `## plugin format`.
  - END's format choice is END's own cells.
  - The architecture default lives once, in the template.
  - The debug-format owner is CMake.
- **E (Explicit):** every lane states its arch and format. A `CAST_PLUGIN_FORMAT` outside `CAST_FORMATS` is fatal.
- **E (Encapsulation):** EVE never reads END. END only calls EVE's words.
- **L (Lean):** existing blocks are reused verbatim from siblings, with no new helper.
- **D (Deterministic):** explicit `-D`/`-U` on every cmake row keeps a reused build folder from holding a stale value.
- **B:** no ownership change.
- **Stateless:** no runtime state added.
